question: At the qualified R11 budget-108 restoration, are the individually necessary final records exactly those whose removal deletes novel phase-anchored support, with all non-novel final-record replacements leaving the restored class structure unchanged?
hypothesis: Across exactly 27 deterministic leave-one-final-record-out interventions, replacing a surface's sample-108 record with its own sample-107 record will reverse full restoration if and only if the removed record supplied support absent from that surface at budget 107. The number of destabilizing interventions will equal the frozen R11 novel-support addition count, while every non-novel replacement will retain nine correct alias triplets and zero splits or cross-entity collisions.

prior_evidence.observation: The actual 108-prefix restored nine correct triplets and zero splits with at least one novel anchored-support addition; an equal-count sham duplicating every surface's sample-107 record added zero novel support and retained the budget-107 ten-class, eight-triplet, one-split structure.

scope_statement: This experiment changes one R11 dimension: the all-surface sham intervention is decomposed into the complete fixed set of 27 single-surface replacements. Streams, motifs, seeds, budgets, representation, induction, capacity, and evaluator-only audit remain unchanged. It makes no population, task-learning, or language-competence claim.
authority: research-only; no deployment, external-model inference, scheduler, queue, accepted-ref, production, broker, live-interface, CKB-plane, or cross-lane authority

arms_and_inputs.budget107_control: Exact first 107 records of each of the 27 frozen independent entity-family streams.
arms_and_inputs.actual108_control: Exact first 108 records of each frozen stream; must reproduce R11 full restoration and novel-support accounting.
arms_and_inputs.single_replacement_arms: Exactly 27 arms indexed surface 0 through 26. Arm i retains actual108 except that surface i sample index 107 is replaced byte-for-byte by that surface's sample index 106 record.
arms_and_inputs.evaluation: For each intervention, exact support-set delta, class cardinality, and evaluator-only entity-membership audit; no task model is trained.

seeds.all_arms: Exact R6-R11 independent seeds. Interventions introduce no random draw and use only the preregistered within-surface sample index 106 replacement.

controls: Budget 107 and actual 108 must exactly reproduce R11's frozen class, triplet, split, collision, and prefix results before intervention output is emitted.
The intervention matrix is the complete fixed set of 27 surface indices; no arm may be selected or omitted after results.
Each intervention changes exactly one record and preserves 108 records per surface and 2916 total records.
Novel removal is determined before class induction by exact five-byte anchored-support membership at budget 107 versus actual 108.
All arms use identical selected motifs, phase coordinate, exact-support representation, class inducer, and evaluator; entity and family labels enter only the post-induction audit.
validity_criteria: Exact parent and North Star identities match.
The local deterministic R11 probe reproduces frozen 107, actual-108, and aggregate sham controls before any R12 output is emitted.

All 27 intervention arms are executed exactly once in ascending surface-index order; each differs from actual108 only at its indexed final record, whose bytes equal the frozen within-surface sample index 106 record.
Every arm has 2916 records, 108 per surface; all context indices and bytes are in range; all 36 unordered entity pairs are audited once per arm.
Novel-support status is computed from exact per-surface support sets without entity or family labels.
All metrics are finite and full Go regression passes before the probe.
No tokenizer, task training, external model, network call, capacity growth, fuzzy matching, threshold change, seed search, adaptive arm selection, or evaluator leakage occurs.

classification_rules.record_locality_supported: Validity and controls pass; every and only intervention removing novel support destabilizes restoration, every non-novel intervention preserves the exact restored class membership, and no intervention creates a cross-entity collision.
classification_rules.novel_support_redundant: Validity and controls pass, but at least one novel-support removal remains fully restored.
classification_rules.nonlocal_record_effect: Validity and controls pass, but at least one non-novel replacement destabilizes restoration.
classification_rules.mixed: Validity and controls pass, but results satisfy none of the preceding scientific rules.
classification_rules.negative_control_failure: Budget 107, actual 108, or the aggregate R11 sham fails any frozen threshold.
classification_rules.incomplete: Compute interruption prevents all 27 fixed interventions.
classification_rules.invalid: Any identity, construction, arm-cardinality, support accounting, leakage, evaluator-boundary, determinism, finite-metric, or qualification criterion fails.

stop_conditions: Stop invalid before science on parent, North Star, R11 replication, intervention construction, build, or frozen-package drift.
After R12 output begins, complete all 27 arms and all frozen evaluations unless infrastructure prevents it.
Do not omit arms, inspect alternate replacement positions, or alter representation, controls, metrics, thresholds, budgets, capacity, or classification after observing R12 output.
no_post_result_tuning_rule: No arm, replacement source, budget, context distribution, sample sequence, seed, representation rule, class learner, control, metric, threshold, capacity, stop condition, or interpretation may change after primary R12 output.
